scenes.line1: Ever seen your app slow to a crawl?
scenes.say: Ever noticed your app slowing way down under load? What causes thread pool starvation, and how can you spot it?

scenes.label: Starvation
scenes.sub: All threads are busy, tasks get delayed.
scenes.say: Thread pool starvation means every thread is busy, so new tasks have to wait. This tanks performance fast.
To diagnose, first monitor thread pool metrics. Next, hunt for blocking or synchronous calls. Finally, analyze patterns to see if delays repeat.

scenes.title: Available Thread Pool Threads
scenes.say: You can check how many threads are available using a built-in method. Low numbers mean your pool is close to starvation.

scenes.question: How should you handle blocking calls?
scenes.right: Refactor to async. Avoid blocking in thread pool tasks.
scenes.say: If you see blocking calls, don't just bump up the thread pool size. Refactor to use async patterns and keep threads free.
